app.name: Bookends Learning
app.tagline: Training and assessment for Aiko, Capiche and Prep

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your training and exams
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password combination is not recognised.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Your account needs approval from a manager before you can sign in.
register.checkEmail: Check your email for a verification link.

pending.title: Awaiting approval
pending.body: Your account has been created and is waiting for a manager to approve it. You’ll be able to sign in as soon as that happens.
pending.suspended: Your account has been suspended. Contact your manager.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your email and we’ll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidBody: Password reset links expire, can only be used once, and must be opened in the browser that requested them. Ask for a new one.

questions.title: Question bank
questions.subtitle: Everything an exam can draw from. Only active questions are eligible.
questions.empty: No questions match. Clear the filters, or write the first one.

choice_single.label: One correct option
choice_single.description: The candidate picks a single option. Marked automatically.

choice_multi.label: Several correct options
choice_multi.description: The candidate ticks every option that applies. Supports partial credit.

boolean.label: True or false
boolean.description: A statement the candidate judges true or false.

blanks.label: Fill in the blanks
blanks.description: A sentence with gaps to type into. Accepts alternative spellings.

pairs.label: Match the following
pairs.description: Each item on the left is paired with one on the right.

order.label: Put in order
order.description: The candidate arranges steps into the correct sequence.

text_short.label: Short written answer
text_short.description: A sentence or two, marked by a chef. Not scored automatically.

text_long.label: Essay
text_long.description: A longer written answer, marked by a chef against a rubric.

evaluator_only.label: Assessed in person
evaluator_only.description: A practical or viva. The candidate types nothing; a chef scores the rubric.

questions.bloomHint: What the question asks the candidate to DO — recall a fact, or judge a situation. Used to check a paper is not all recall.
questions.provenanceHint: Where this question came from. Recorded once and not editable — an edit does not make an imported question hand-written.
questions.usageHint: Times placed on a fixed paper. Rule-based exams draw at the start of each attempt and are not counted.

sort.label: Sort by
sort.ascending: Sorted A to Z. Choose again to reverse.
sort.descending: Sorted Z to A. Choose again to reverse.

saved.label: Saved filters
saved.nothingToSave: Choose a filter before saving one.

bulk.capped: Selected the first {limit} of {total}. Narrow the filter to reach the rest.
bulk.confirmRemoveBody: They stop appearing in the bank and can no longer be drawn. Past attempts that used them are unaffected, and you can restore them from the recycle bin.
bulk.confirmRestoreBody: They return to the bank with the status they had when they were removed.
bulk.confirmPublishBody: Each one is validated first. Any that are not ready are left alone and listed back to you.
bulk.statusBody: Moves that are not allowed from a question’s current status are skipped, not forced.
bulk.selectAllRows: Select every question on this page

shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.selectAll: Select every row on this page

quality.title: Question quality
quality.subtitle: What the attempt data says about the bank, and what is missing from it.
quality.drawableHint: Active or approved, and not removed.
quality.measuredHint: Answered enough times for a statistic to mean anything.
quality.needsAttentionHint: Measured, and the numbers say something is wrong.
quality.recommendationsHint: About the bank as a whole, rather than any one question.
quality.questionsHint: Unmeasured questions sort last — they are not bad, only unknown.

dimensionHint.bloom: A bank that is all recall cannot test judgement.
dimensionHint.difficulty: A single difficulty cannot tell candidates apart.
dimensionHint.category: Rules draw by category, so an empty one can never be satisfied.
dimensionHint.type: Written questions need a human to mark them.

distractors.title: Which option candidates chose
distractors.hint: From every settled attempt. The only report that separates a misleading question from a mis-keyed one.
distractors.notApplicable: This question type has no options to analyse.

exams.title: Exams
exams.subtitle: Papers drawn from the question bank, scheduled and assigned to staff.
exams.empty: No exams match. Clear the filters, or build the first one.
exams.lockedNotice: This exam is published, so its content is fixed. Duplicate it to make changes — the closing time and who it is assigned to can still be edited.

sections.title: Sections and questions
sections.none: No sections yet. Add one, then a rule saying which questions to draw.
sections.noRules: No rules yet — this section would draw nothing.
sections.takenByEarlier: {count} already taken by an earlier rule
sections.marksPartial: {questions} questions · at least {known} marks ({unknown} take each question’s own marks)

form.newSubtitle: Settings first. Sections and questions are added once it exists.
form.title: Title
form.instructionsPlaceholder: Read each question carefully. You cannot return to a section once you leave it.
form.paperModeFixedHint: One paper is drawn when you publish, and every candidate sits the same questions. Scores are comparable.
form.paperModePerAttemptHint: A fresh paper is drawn each time somebody starts. Repeated practice is not repeated memorisation, but scores are not strictly comparable.
form.rulesHint: How the exam is taken and how it is marked.
form.verificationHint: Choose one chef if your outlet only has one — requiring two where only one exists leaves every result stuck forever.
form.shuffleQuestionsHint: Each candidate sees the questions in a different order.
form.shuffleOptionsHint: Multiple-choice options are reordered per candidate.
form.allowBacktrackHint: Candidates can return to earlier questions before submitting.
form.negativeMarkingHint: Wrong answers lose marks. Skipped questions never do.

health.title: Exam health
health.readyToPublish: This exam is ready to publish.
health.notReady: Some things must be fixed before this can be published.
health.publishedDescription: Checks run against the paper this exam drew.
health.advisoryHint: These do not stop you publishing.
health.published: Published. The audience has been notified.
health.confirmBody: The paper is drawn and frozen now, and everyone assigned is notified. Published exams cannot be edited — you would have to duplicate it to make changes.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: When candidates can sit this exam. Leave blank to open it manually.
schedule.lockedDescription: This exam is published. Only its closing time can still move.
schedule.closesStillEditable: Extending this is allowed after publishing — a shift running late is not a reason to rebuild the exam.
schedule.timezoneHint: The wall clock these times refer to, not the one your browser is in.

assign.title: Who sits this exam
assign.description: Assignments can be changed after publishing — the paper is fixed, the audience is not.
assign.none: Nobody is assigned yet, so this exam would reach no one.

paper.title: The paper
paper.empty: No questions yet. Add a section with a rule, and they will appear here.
paper.previewNotice: This is one example draw, not anybody’s paper. Every candidate gets their own questions when they start, so what you see here is the shape and difficulty the rules produce, not what any individual will be asked.
paper.revisionHint: Which wording of the question was frozen. Analytics group by it so two versions never merge into one statistic.

fallback.difficulty_widened: No question matched the requested difficulty exactly, so a nearby one was used.
fallback.short: The rule could not be filled completely.

errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to view this.
errors.pendingApproval: Your account is still awaiting approval.

sitting.title: My exams
sitting.subtitle: Exams assigned to you.
sitting.empty: You have no exams to sit right now.
sitting.emptyHint: When your manager assigns one, it will appear here.
sitting.confirmStartBody: The timer starts now and runs on the server. Closing the tab will not pause it.
sitting.confirmSubmitBody: You have answered {answered} of {total} questions. You cannot change your answers after submitting.
sitting.timeUpBody: Your exam was submitted automatically when the time ran out.
sitting.resultPending: Your result has not been released yet. You will be notified when it is ready.
sitting.startFailed: This exam could not be started.
sitting.timeAnnounce: {minutes, plural, one {# minute remaining} other {# minutes remaining}}
sitting.timeAnnounceSeconds: {seconds, plural, one {# second remaining} other {# seconds remaining}}
sitting.noBacktrack: This exam does not allow going back.

evaluation.title: Evaluate
evaluation.subtitle: Papers waiting to be marked.
evaluation.emptyHint: Papers needing a human appear here as candidates submit them.
evaluation.sentBack: Sent back {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}}
evaluation.question: Question {position}
evaluation.autoFlagged: The auto-grader asked for this one to be confirmed.
evaluation.unmarkedWarning: Every question needs a mark before you can finish.
evaluation.verifySubtitle: Marked papers waiting to be signed off.
evaluation.verifyEmptyHint: Marked papers appear here, along with auto-graded ones held for release.
evaluation.yourOwnWork: You marked this paper, so somebody else must sign it off.
evaluation.confirmReturnBody: It returns to the evaluator for re-marking, and any sign-offs already given are discarded.

results.title: Results
results.subtitle: Every exam you have finished.
results.emptyHint: Once you finish an exam and the result is released, it appears here.
results.pendingHint: Marked or being marked. You will be told when the result is ready.
results.question: Question {position}
results.notReleased: This result has not been released yet.
results.standingHint: Your best result compared with everyone at your company.
results.standingSuppressedHint: A position is only shown once at least ten people at your company have a released result. Below that, a rank would say more about your colleagues than about you.
results.standingNoneHint: Once a result is released, your position will appear here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: How you are doing.
reports.noDataHint: Once you have sat an exam and the result is released, your record appears here.
reports.strengthsHint: Weakest first — the top of this list is what to revise.
reports.noCategories: Not enough answers yet to break this down by topic.
reports.teamHint: Everyone in reach, including those who have not started.
reports.questionsHint: How questions actually behave, against how they were rated.
reports.noQuestions: No question has been answered enough times to report on.
reports.question: Question
reports.notEnoughHint: Needs at least 10 responses before this means anything.
reports.misratedHint: This question behaves two bands away from how it was rated.
reports.noExams: No exam has been sat yet.

translations.title: Translations
translations.subtitle: Say this question in another language.
translations.templateHint: Keep every {{blank}} exactly as it appears in English — they become the answer boxes.
translations.nothingToTranslate: This format has nothing beyond the question itself.
translations.staleHint: The English was reworded after this translation was written. Check it still matches.
translations.selfReviewed: Approved by the person who wrote it
translations.previewHint: What a candidate reading this language will see.
translations.reviewFirst: A translation is reviewed before it is published.
translations.publishedEditWarning: Editing a published translation sends it back for review.

dashboard.subtitle: Everything waiting on you, in one place.
dashboard.attentionEmptyHint: Papers to mark, sign off or release will appear here.
dashboard.myExamsHint: Assigned to you and open now.
dashboard.nothingHereHint: When an exam is assigned to you, or a paper needs your attention, it will appear here.
dashboard.overviewHint: Live figures for everyone in your reach.
dashboard.examPerformanceHint: Papers people have actually sat, weakest first.
dashboard.weeklyEngagementHint: Attempts started and completed per week, split by training and assessment.
dashboard.departmentPerformanceHint: Pass rate and average score for each department and outlet.
dashboard.liveActivityHint: Who approved whom, who changed a role, who published an exam.
dashboard.trendsHint: How each figure above has moved since the previous period.
